plugin.name: StudyMaster
plugin.description: Wizard-of-Oz remote control: a single authenticated wizard connects over WebSocket to observe the running flow and set author-wired variables.

required.name: ws_port
required.description: WebSocket port the wizard client connects to. Auto-allocated by PortPoolManager in hosted deployments; used directly in local/LAN runs.

required.name: wizard_key
required.description: Shared secret the wizard must submit as the first WebSocket message before any other message is accepted. No default: the author must set one.

optional.name: wizard_slug
optional.description: Author-chosen slug for the friendly hosted URL https://<host>/studymaster/<slug>. Empty = no friendly alias registered; the wizard connects with the raw pooled URL/port.

optional.name: controls_file
optional.description: Project-relative path to the manifest declaring which SceneFlow variables the wizard can see and set.

optional.name: producer_key
optional.description: Shared secret a participant-facing htmlgui-ws vsm-webcam element must submit to register as the live-video producer. Empty (default) disables live wizard video entirely; unrelated to wizard_key.

optional.name: ice_servers
optional.description: JSON array of WebRTC ICE server entries (e.g. [{"urls":"stun:stun.l.google.com:19302"},{"urls":"turn:relay.example.org:3478","username":"...","credential":"..."}]) handed to both the wizard's and the participant's RTCPeerConnection. Empty on a LAN, where direct host candidates connect without STUN/TURN.

optional.name: connected_var
optional.description: Bool SceneFlow variable set to true while a wizard is connected, false otherwise (default) — same pattern as htmlgui-ws's sceneflowStateVar/gui_connected. Must be declared as a Bool variable in the SceneFlow; unrelated to the video producer's connection state.

commands.name: request
commands.summary: Block the flow until the wizard answers a wizard-controllable variable
commands.description: Sends a 'request' message to the connected wizard for the named variable (which must appear in the controls manifest) and blocks the executing activity until the wizard replies or the project is stopped. There is no timeout.

params.name: var
params.description: Variable name; must be declared in the controls manifest (controls_file).

params.name: prompt
params.description: Question text shown to the wizard, overriding the manifest's label for this call.

commands.name: show_asrinput
commands.summary: Push a recorded audio file to the wizard for playback and review
commands.description: Sends the connected wizard an audio player for the given MP3, with a VAD-activity timeline and transcript read from the <basename>.json sidecar the fast-asr server saves alongside each recording (from the asr plugin's start_recording/stop_recording). The player auto-seeks to 250ms before the first detected speech onset. Assumes the fast-asr server's recordings are readable at that same path on the machine running this plugin (typically the same host, per the asr plugin's recording_dir). If no sidecar JSON is found next to the mp3, the wizard still gets the audio player, just without the timeline.

params.name: var
params.description: Full path to the recorded MP3 file — NOT a variable name to look up (unlike request()'s 'var'). Pass the already-resolved value, typically the asr plugin's asr_last_recording_file, e.g. PlayAction("[sm show_asrinput var='" + asr_last_recording_file + "']").

commands.name: start_recording
commands.summary: Tell the wizard console to start recording the live video feed
commands.description: Sends the connected wizard console a signal to start recording whatever it's currently receiving from the video producer (MediaRecorder, client-side only — see plugin README). A no-op if no wizard is connected or no live feed is playing; the wizard console itself logs that case rather than this plugin, since the recording state lives entirely in that browser.

commands.name: stop_recording
commands.summary: Tell the wizard console to stop recording and save the file
commands.description: Sends the connected wizard console a signal to stop an in-progress recording and save it — the same effect as clicking "Stop & Save" in the console. A no-op if nothing is currently recording.

writes.description: Set to true while a wizard is connected, false otherwise (default). Default variable name is studymaster_connected — same pattern as htmlgui-ws's gui_connected. Must be declared as a Bool variable in the SceneFlow.
